transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Uh, well... I guess things have just been a bit tense lately. Ever since my father-in-law moved in with us, really. I mean, I'm holding it together at work fine. But at home, and with my coursework, I'm just... more wound up, I guess. A bit shorter than I'm used to being. And I've kind of stopped doing the things that usually keep my head clear... like fishing, or woodworking... even skipping my first-aid workshops. Just... yeah.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?
Uh... I don't know if I'd call it anxious. Not really. Just... like I said before, just tense. I'm not sitting around worrying about things, if that's what you mean. Just... wound up.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
Uh... no. Not really. I wouldn't say I'm sad. Just... what I said before. Just tense.
Are you avoiding any places or situations because of your father-in-law moving in?
Uh... no. Not really. I mean, I still go to work and come home. I'm not... hiding out anywhere, if that's what you're asking. Just... going about my day.
Have you been having any recurring thoughts or urges that you can't seem to get out of your head?
Uh... no. Nothing like that. I don't have any... weird urges or whatever. Just thinking about the usual day-to-day stuff. Nothing stuck in my head.
Have you been feeling more tired than usual lately?
No, not really. I mean, the shifts can be long, but... it's just the usual tired. Nothing out of the ordinary.
Have you been snapping at people or getting angry more easily than you used to?

Yeah... I suppose so. I mean, I hold it together at work fine. But at home, or when I'm trying to focus on my coursework... I guess I've been a bit more wound up. Shorter than I'm used to being. It's just been a lot since my father-in-law moved in. I've even stopped doing the things that usually keep my head clear... haven't gone fishing, or done any woodworking... even skipping my first-aid workshops. So... yeah. I guess I have been a little short.
Are there any specific interactions or situations with your father-in-law that you try to avoid?
No... not really. I don't go out of my way to avoid him or anything like that. We just... kind of share the house. There isn't any specific thing I'm dodging, if that's what you mean.
Have you been having any thoughts that keep repeating in your mind?
No. Not really. Just the usual stuff, I guess. Nothing that just plays over and over.
Do you find yourself avoiding talking to your father-in-law about certain topics?
No, I don't think so. We just talk about normal things. There's nothing I'm trying to avoid.
Have you been having any trouble sleeping lately?
No, my sleep is... it's fine. I get to sleep okay. Haven't really had any issues with it.
Have you been doing anything over and over that you feel like you can't control?
No. Not really. I don't... I don't do anything like that.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?

I guess... maybe a little. I just haven't really felt like doing my usual stuff lately. Ever since my father-in-law moved in with us, I've started skipping things... fishing, woodworking. Even the first-aid workshops I usually go to. They normally keep my head clear, but... I don't know. 

I manage to hold it together at work fine, but at home and with my coursework, I'm just... more wound up and short than I'm used to. So, yeah... I just haven't been doing much else.
How long have you been feeling this way since your father-in-law moved in?
Um... about four months. Yeah, it's been about four months since he moved into the house.
Do you feel irritable most of the time, even when you're not directly interacting with your father-in-law?
I wouldn't say most of the time. Just... sometimes. It's mostly just when I'm at home, I guess. I just try to keep to myself.
Do you feel anxious when you're alone with your thoughts?
Not really. I don't... I wouldn't say I get anxious. I don't really spend a lot of time just sitting around thinking about it all. I just try not to dwell on things too much.
Have you had difficulty concentrating on your coursework since your father-in-law moved in?

Yeah... a little bit. I mean, I'm still doing my regular EMT shifts fine. But... yeah, I've fallen behind on some of the paramedic coursework. And... I guess I've kind of stopped showing up for those community first-aid workshops I usually help out with. Just... haven't really had the focus for the extra stuff lately.
Do you feel like you're always on edge, even when things are going well?
No, I don't think so. I'm not... on edge all the time. Just... normal, I guess, when things are fine.
Have you experienced any significant changes in your appetite since your father-in-law moved in?
Not really. I guess... I still eat about the same. Haven't really noticed a difference there.
Have you been feeling this way for more than six months?
No... not quite that long. It's been, I don't know, about four months. Just... since my father-in-law moved into the house.
